plan: My private value is $15. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid my true value. However, other rational bidders will anticipate this. Since the game is one round, I'll slightly shade my bid below my true value to protect against potential losses. I'll bid $14.5, which is just below my value. This allows potential profit if others bid higher, while protecting against significant losses.
